patterns.documented_behavior: One source block, multiple live instances. Source ACL controls read/edit; instance protection is local. Unsync copy retains text; deleting source can preserve or remove copies; history at original; mobile read-only.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test inaccessible original, stale permission, deletion confirmation, detach, sync conflicts and mobile.

patterns.documented_behavior: Block drag handle reveals contextual actions, insertion guideline, keyboard movement; heading collapse and two-stage Select All when enabled.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test keyboard/touch discovery, multi-selection, focus, undo and collapsed range.

patterns.documented_behavior: Drag/resize causes neighboring cards to adjust; optional compaction; up to five recent layout undos, reset by other edits; per-card refresh and freshness label.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test grid reflow, responsive constraints, undo boundary, failed refresh and stale data.

patterns.documented_behavior: Configurable warning when attempting to close work blocked by dependencies.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test allowed override, cancellation, source permissions and keyboard.

patterns.documented_behavior: Warn before closing if unresolved subtasks, comments or checklist items remain; scope configured by Space.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test resolve versus continue, navigation to offending items, counts, and no warning when complete.

patterns.documented_behavior: Central manager organized by Space; current context selected based on entry point; task tags distinct from document and time tags.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test global versus local scope, renaming impact, empty results and deletion.

patterns.documented_behavior: Canvas references to tasks and Docs allow edits; convert freeform items to tasks; export excludes embedded tasks/Docs.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test same object identity, access, remove reference versus delete source and export disclosure.

patterns.documented_behavior: Draft, scheduled and sent tabs; draft stays local to originating device and expires after 90 days; row actions for edits, reschedule, send or delete.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test accidental navigation, cross-device limitation, time zone, failure and expiry disclosure.

patterns.documented_behavior: A user can choose a preferred mobile launch destination.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test permission changes, deleted destination and fallback.

patterns.documented_behavior: Vendor describes parallel inspection of untrusted content and confirmation before flagged writes/external actions; autonomous runs are policy-dependent.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test false positives, denial, audit trace and noninteractive policy. Not security certification.

patterns.documented_behavior: Index begins after connection, updates periodically or via events, and is removed on disconnect. Personal vs organizational connections have different visibility.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test index progress, source ACL change, disconnect, stale results and cross-user access.

patterns.documented_behavior: ClickUp server uses OAuth and exposes permitted actions; Connected Search from external apps remains in-workspace.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test tool scope, consent, revocation, destructive actions and authorization failure.

patterns.documented_behavior: Delivery health changes to failing after non-success or over seven seconds; up to five retries per event; suspension at fail count 100 or 401/410. Exhausted events not replayed automatically.
patterns.proposed_validation: Test deduplication, reconciliation, queue, retry policy and observability.
